Reproduced host-local with the same binary: -S 3832054505 and -S 2147483648 exit 90 with the usage line; -S 2147483647 and -S 1 run (rc=0). The old draw put 10022 of 20000 seeds above INT_MAX. The detector fix is in the tree: tests/suite/fsx.sh now draws 1..2^31-1 (20000 draws, none outside) and keeps a failing check's fsx log on the node with its path in the record instead of deleting it. Nothing in the run is evidence about MeshXFS either way: fsx never opened its file.
